Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That's all from this contest. Afghanistan have grabbed another vital 10 points in the World Cup Super League. The third ODI of the series will be played on Tuesday, 25th January 2022. The first ball of this clash will be bowled at 12.30 pm IST (7 am GMT). But as you know, the buildup will begin well in advance so make sure you tune in early. Cheers!
Rahmanullah Gurbaz is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his knock of 103 runs.

Afghanistan would be extremely pleased with their bowling effort and they well and truly deserve to win this game as well as the series. It was once again Mujeeb Ur Rahman who stole the show with the ball and he finished with 4 wickets to his name. All the bowlers executed their plans to perfection and they hardly gave away any freebies to Netherlands' batters. Fareed Ahmad was also impressive with the ball as he picked up a couple of wickets and kept the batters in check. Rashid Khan, the magician, got just the one wicket but he too was very economical and kept the Dutch batters on their toes. All in all, it was a dominant display from Afghanistan and they take an unassailable lead of 2-0 in the series.

Netherlands had a tough ask in front of them and they have only themselves to blame. Their approach during the chase will be questioned as at no point they looked like chasing it down. After losing a couple of wickets early on in the innings, Scott Edwards and Bas de Leede got together and steadied the ship. But they found it hard to rotate the strike and as a result, there was a passage of play in the middle overs where they hardly got any runs off boundaries. They did put on a partnership of 90 runs but never did they look like chasing down the total. Once they lost Bas de Leede, wickets kept tumbling and Netherlands completely lost their way. Scott Edwards did get to his fifty and he was the only batter who showed some fight and resistance. No other batter managed to get in and score freely and the Dutch were handed a defeat in the end.

A comfortable win in the end for Afghanistan and they seal the ODI series with one more game to go. Netherlands have once again fallen short of the target. Even though they went in with a plan of keeping wickets in hand, they failed to keep up with the asking rate and that has cost them this game.

OUT! TIMBER! That's it! Mujeeb Ur Rahman finishes things off and he grabs his fourth wicket! A loopy ball, full and outside off. Vivian Kingma looks to sweep this but misses it completely. The ball knocks the stumps over. Afghanistan win the match and seal the series! They have outplayed Netherlands and have comfortably won the game by 48 runs!
Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Vivian Kingma looks for a slog but he misses.

OUT! TAKEN! Mujeeb Ur Rahman gets another and Netherlands are falling like a pack of cards now! This is a flatter ball, outside off. Fred Klaassen looks to cut but it goes off the outer half of the bat towards the short third man fielder. Gulbadin Naib there takes an easy catch. Vivian Kingma is the last man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Gulbadin Naib b Mujeeb Ur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! Flatter ball, turning down leg. Fred Klaassen misses his flick and the umpire calls it as a wide.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another one bites the dust! Tossed up, around off. Philippe Boissevain looks to slog sweep but he gets a tickle on it and the ball goes straight towards the keeper. Rahmanullah Gurbaz takes a sharp catch behind the sticks. Fred Klaassen is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Rahmanullah Gurbaz b Mujeeb Ur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, outside off. Philippe Boissevain dabs it towards cover and takes a quick single. Netherlands need 49 runs off 3 overs.
Philippe Boissevain walks out to bat.

OUT! RUN OUT! Netherlands conitnue to tumble down! A flatter ball, around middle. Ryan Klein tucks it towards deep mid-wicket. One run is completed and Saqib Zulfiqar wanted the second run and he takes off to the other end. He is denied the run by his partner. Rahmat Shah throws the ball at the keeper's end. Rahmanullah Gurbaz collects the ball and takes the bails off in his own sweet time. Netherlands in deep trouble. They have lost their seventh wicket now.

A length ball, outside off. Ryan Klein defends it out towards cover and takes a single. Shahidi has a shy at the keeper's end. The ball deflects off the stumps and rolls away. The batters steal an overthrow.
Slower full toss, around middle. Ryan Klein flicks it away towards deep mid-wicket for brace.
Back of a length, outside off. Saqib Zulfiqar punches it to cover and scampers through to the other end.
On a length, outside off. Saqib Zulfiqar cuts it away past cover for a brace.
Fuller, around off. Saqib Zulfiqar taps it towards cover for a single.
Touch fuller, around middle. Riaz Hussan gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single.
Another beauty! What a ripper! This one was a googly, pitching it on middle and turning it in and missing the leg pole. Riaz Hussan fails to pick up the wrong'un and gets beaten on the inside egde.
Tossed up, on middle. Saqib Zulfiqar reverse-sweeps this towards third man for a single.
Beaten! A loopy ball, full and outside off. Saqib Zulfiqar looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge as the ball spins away from him.

Tad quicker, around middle. Ryan Klein tucks it towards mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end. Rashid Khan runs towards the ball collects it and has a shy at the non-striker's end. He hits the stump directly but the batter seems to have made his ground.
Is that a run out? A direct hit from Rashid Khan at his end and this could be close. The umpire has sent it upstairs and the replays roll in. Klein has just made it to the other end and he survives.
Another slower ball and another play and a miss! Fuller in length, outside off. Saqib Zulfiqar looks to heave it but he fails to get any bat on it.
Play and a miss! A slower ball, fuller in length, well outside off. Saqib Zulfiqar looks to cut but he fails to get any bat on it.
Good-length ball, on off. Ryan Klein looks to push it through the off side but it goes off the thick inside edge towards mid-wicket for a run.
On a length, around off. Ryan Klein taps it to the man at backward point.

Ouch! Ryan Klein has been hit on the neck by the fielder. He is down on the ground in pain. The physio is out there to check on him. Luckily, it was not a hard throw by the fielder. Ryan Klein is fine and good to resume!

OUCH! That will hurt! This was a full toss, outside off. Ryan Klein slices it towards backward point. The fielder there collects the ball and throws it to the striker's end. The ball hits Klein just under his helmet on the neck and he looks in some serious pain.
Back of a length, outside off. Saqib Zulfiqar taps it to the off side and takes a quick run.
Fareed Ahmad (7-1-18-2) is back on!
A googly, on a length, around middle. Saqib Zulfiqar stays back and tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Ryan Klein comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rashid Khan gets his man and Netherlands fall into a deeper hole! Tossed up nicely, around middle. Boris Gorlee gets down on his knee and tries to sweep. The ball goes off the top edge, in the air towards short fine leg. Yamin Ahmadzai there, settles under it and takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Yamin Ahmadzai b Rashid Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Saqib Zulfiqar cuts it to deep cover for a single.
BEATEN! That is a peach of a delivery from Rashid Khan! Tossed up, outside off and turning away late. Saqib Zulfiqar looks to block but the ball spins past his outside edge.
A quicker ball, on a length, around off. Boris Gorlee rocks back and cuts it to deep cover for a run.
Tossed up, around off. Boris Gorlee lunges forward and blocks it out.
Rashid Khan (7-0-24-0) is brought back into the attack.
Fuller in length, outside off. Boris Gorlee digs it out on the off side and takes a single. 68 runs needed off 42 balls.
Leg bye! A slower ball, angling in from middle. Saqib Zulfiqar misses his nudge on the leg side. The ball deflects off his pad towards the keeper. A leg bye taken!
A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Saqib Zulfiqar stays back to push it through the off side but he misses.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Netherlands more of these! Fuller in length, outside off. Saqib Zulfiqar prods and carves it through the cover region for a boundary.
Play and a miss! Back of a length, outside off and nipping back in late. Saqib Zulfiqar looks to cut but he misses.
Full ball, around off. Boris Gorlee shuffles across to scoop but it goes off the toe end towards square leg for a run.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman fires in a quicker ball, around leg. Saqib Zulfiqar misses his flick and gets hit on his pad.
Length ball, around off. Saqib Zulfiqar blocks it watchfully.
Flatter ball, around leg. Boris Gorlee nudges it behind square on the leg side for a run.
Leg bye! Flatter ball, drifting down leg. Saqib Zulfiqar misses his flick and gets hit on his pad. The batters steal a leg bye.
Flatter ball, around off. Saqib Zulfiqar defends it.
On a length, around middle. Saqib Zulfiqar keeps it out.

Is that a run out? There is a direct hit at the bowler's end. The replay rolls in and shows that Pieter Seelaar was short of his ground when the ball knocked the stumps over. The big screen shows out and he has to walk back to the hut.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, dear! That is very casual from Netherlands' skipper! Back of a length, outside off. Boris Gorlee cuts it towards cover. The fielder there collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Pieter Seelaar was short of his crease and he is a goner!

Whooaa! That is a terrific save from Gulbadin Naib at long on! Length ball, outside off. Pieter Seelaar heaves it high in the air towards long on. Naib there, hops and takes the catch. He realizes that the momentum is taking him over the ropes so he pushes the ball back in play. The batters take a single.
Leg bye! A stifled appeal for LBW but turned down! Length ball, angling in from middle. Boris Gorlee misses his flick and gets hit on his pad. The ball rolls to the off side for a leg bye.
Good-length ball, outside off. Pieter Seelaar looks to drive on the up but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Length ball, in the slot, outside off. Pieter Seelaar prods and drills it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
On a length, around middle. Boris Gorlee tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Time for Powerplay 3! Afghanistan can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the ring till the 50th over.
Loopy ball, full and around off. Boris Gorlee presses forward and taps it towards cover for a quick single.
Flatter ball, on middle. Boris Gorlee punches it back to the bowler.
Fuller ball, on middle. Boris Gorlee blocks it out towards cover.

FOUR! Top shot! A loopy ball, very full, around the leg side. Boris Gorlee waits for it and whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. He gets off the mark in style. Also, that brings up the 150 for Netherlands.
Slower through the air, on middle. Boris Gorlee leans and looks to defend this, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards point.
Flatter ball, outside off. Pieter Seelaar taps it towards cover and takes a single.
Boris Gorlee walks in at number 6.

OUT! LBW! A huge wicket for Afghanistan! A century is denied for Scott Edwards! A beautiful delivery by Yamin Ahmadzai. On a length, jagging back in on middle. Scott Edwards looks to flick this away but misses and gets rapped on the front pad. A huge appeal and the umpire raises his finger. A body blow for Netherlands as Scott Edwards walks back to the hut.
Good-length delivery, around off. Scott Edwards steps down and pushes it back to the bowler.
Length ball, outside off. Scott Edwards defends it out towards cover.
Fuller this time, outside off. Scott Edwards drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Pieter Seelaar hangs back and pushes it towards deep cover. A single taken.
WIDE! Fuller, spraying it down the leg side. Pieter Seelaar misses his flick. Wide given.
Touch slower, outside off, on a length. Scott Edwards stays in his crease and slashes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Pieter Seelaar leans and blocks it out.
Another fuller ball, slower through the air, outside off. Pieter Seelaar looks to defend this but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full again, outside off. Scott Edwards pushes it towards long off for a single.

FOUR! Edgy runs! Tosses it up again, outside off, spinning away again. Scott Edwards goes for the drive and gets a thick outside edge past the slip fielder all the way towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Beaten! Loopy ball, spinning away from outside off. Scott Edwards leans to drive but misses.
A leg break, around middle, short in length. Scott Edwards stays back and blocks it out.
Slower ball, shorter this time. Scott Edwards pulls it towards deep square leg for a single. He retains the strike.
Swing and a miss! Wide of off, on a length. Scott Edwards looks to drive this but fails to get any bat on it.
On a length, outside off. Scott Edwards looks to cut this away but gets an inside edge back to the bowler.
Fuller, and outside off. Pieter Seelaar drives past the cover fielder for a single.
Touch shorter, outside off. Scott Edwards dabs it to point and rotates the strike.
On a length, outside off. Scott Edwards stays back and blocks it out.

DRINKS! Afghanistan have broken the partnership and they will be breathing a bit easy now! Netherlands need to get a move on here if they are to chase down the total. Scott Edwards is the set batter here and he must ensure that he bats deep and the other batters score at a brisk pace. Afghanistan will look to chip in with wickets and insert more pressure on the Dutch batters.
Another fuller ball, on middle. Scott Edwards knocks it down to long on for a single. He retains the strike.
Fuller ball, outside off. Pieter Seelaar leans and drives it to cover for a single.
Wrong'un this time, around middle. Scott Edwards hangs back and tucks it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Edgy runs! Another fuller ball, around middle. Scott Edwards looks to defend this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Loopy ball this time around middle. Pieter Seelaar leans and taps it towards point for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Scott Edwards taps it towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Length ball, angling in from middle. Scott Edwards glances it towards fine leg for a run. 101 runs needed off 90 balls.
Good-length ball, on off. Scott Edwards punches it to the man at extra cover.
On a length, outside off. Pieter Seelaar cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Pieter Seelaar taps it to the off side.
Pieter Seelaar, the skipper of Netherlands, comes to bat at number 5.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Fareed Ahmad strikes and Afghanistan get the much-needed breakthrough! This was a good-length ball, jagging back in from outside off. Bas de Leede looks to block it but it goes off the inside edge and crashes onto his stumps. Huge moment in this game as a set batter walks back to the hut. It wasn't a fluent innings in any sense from Bas de Leede but he would have loved to carry on, considering that it is not the easiest of pitches to bat on. Afghanistan are back into this contest now.
Back of a length, outside off. Scott Edwards carves it through the cover-point region and takes a single.
A quicker ball, just outside off. Bas de Leede looks to block but he misses as the ball zips past his blade.
On a length, around off. Bas de Leede keeps it out.

DROPPED! A tough one for the slip fielder though! Flatter ball, on a length, just outside off and turning away late. Bas de Leede looks to poke at it and it goes off the outside edge, ricochets off the keeper's glove and towards the slip fielder. Gulbadin Naib there puts it down.
WIDE! A googly, fuller, down the leg side. Bas de Leede misses his flick. Wide called.
A quicker ball, on a length, around off. Scott Edwards stays back and taps it towards backward point.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Bas de Leede cuts it towards deep cover for a run.
Tossed up, around off. Bas de Leede defends it off the front foot.
Rashid Khan (4-0-7-0) comes back to bowl.
Back of a length, outside off. Scott Edwards punches it to the man at cover. 117 runs needed off 102 balls.
Good-length ball, outside off. Scott Edwards defends it to the off side.
Full ball, outside off. Scott Edwards drives but straight to the man at cover.

A slight mix-up but Edwards survives! Good-length ball, around off. Scott Edwards taps it to the off side and looks for a run but is sent back by his partner. The fielder at cover has a shy at the striker's end but he misses.
Well bowled! Into the blockhole, around middle. Bas de Leede digs it out to the leg side for a single.
Good-length ball, on off. Scott Edwards taps it to the off side for a run.
Flatter ball, around leg. Scott Edwards nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Wide! Flatter ball, turning down leg. Scott Edwards misses his flick and the umpire calls it as a wide.
Fuller in length, around middle. Bas de Leede clips it towards deep mid-wicket and the batters collect three runs.
Flatter ball, outside off. Scott Edwards cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Flatter ball, angling in from middle. Scott Edwards turns it towards mid-wicket. Three dots in a row and the pressure is building on the batters.
On a length, just outside off. Scott Edwards blocks it out.
Flatter ball, on off. Scott Edwards taps it to the off side.

Leg bye! Good change of pace from Ahmadzai! A slower ball, into the wicket, around off. Scott Edwards gets low to pull but he gets deceived completely by the change of pace and misses his shot. It hits him near the rib-cage and deflects to the on side. The batters cross for a leg bye.
Fuller in length this time, angling in from middle. Scott Edwards digs it out to the leg side.
Good running! Good-length ball, around off. Bas de Leede taps it towards backward point and takes off for a quick run.
Short of a length, outside off. Scott Edwards stays back and steers it to third man for a run.
On a length, around middle. Scott Edwards defends it to the leg side.
Good-length ball, on middle. Scott Edwards blocks it out.
Tosses it up again, on middle. Bas de Leede shows the full face of the bat and pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, full and outside off. Bas de Leede drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Fuller ball, on middle. Scott Edwards goes for the reverse-sweep, but the ball goes off the toe end towards third man for a single.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Scott Edwards tucks it towards deep square leg for two runs.
Slower this time, around off. Scott Edwards leans and blocks it on the off side.
Tad quicker, around middle. Bas de Leede pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Scott Edwards pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Angling back in, on a length. Bas de Leede taps it towards point and scampers through to the other end.
Length ball, nipping back in sharply, outside off. Bas de Leede looks to drive but misses. Some reverse swing for Yamin Ahmadzai!
In the air...but safe! Change of pace this time, slower ball, outside off. Bas de Leede chips it to the left of the bowler.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Scott Edwards cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Slower ball, outside off, on a length. Scott Edwards drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Slower through the air, around middle, full in length. Bas de Leede leans and defends it out.
Fuller, outside off. Scott Edwards pushes it towards point and scampers through to the other end.
Much quicker this time, outside off. Scott Edwards hangs back and taps it to point.
Touch shorter, outside off. Scott Edwards pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Top shot! Tad quicker, full, down the leg side. Scott Edwards gets low and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Flatter ball, on middle. Bas de Leede steps down and pushes it towards long off. A single taken.
Full again on the pads. Bas de Leede works it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Drifting down the leg side, touch fuller. Scott Edwards closes the face of the bat and pushes it to mid on for a quick single.
On a length, nipping back in around off. Bas de Leede looks to drive but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Another length delivery, outside off. Scott Edwards cuts it off the back foot towards sweeper cover and rotates the strike.
On the pads again, on a length. Scott Edwards works it away towards square leg. No run there.
Fuller ball, down the leg side, Bas de Leede clips it towards fine leg. The fielder dives and stops the ball from crossing the ropes. Saved a certain boundary here. Three runs taken.
Shorter ball, around middle and off. Bas de Leede knocks it down to long on for a single.
Flatter again, around middle. Bas de Leede clips it to the fielder at mid-wicket once again.
Touch shorter, around middle. Bas de Leede flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Bas de Leede blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter ball, around middle. Scott Edwards, on the back foot, pushes it towards long off for a single.
Flatter ball, around middle. Bas de Leede flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Sharafuddin Ashraf is back on!
Back of a length, outside off. Scott Edwards taps it to the man at backward point. Netherlands need 152 runs from 150 balls to win this match!
Good-length delivery, around off. Scott Edwards dabs it onto the deck.
Short of a length, outside off. Bas de Leede punches it to deep cover for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Bas de Leede punches it towards mid on.
On a length, around middle. Bas de Leede tucks it to mid-wicket.

Back of a length, around off. Scott Edwards taps it to the off side and scampers through to the other end. Back-to-back fifties for Scott Edwards! Top innings from Edwards so far but he would be aware that the job is only half done and Netherlands still have a long way to go here!
Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Bas de Leede keeps it out watchfully.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Bas de Leede sways away from the line of the ball.

An appeal for LBW but the umpire says no! A quicker ball this time, around middle. Bas de Leede lunges forward to block but he misses and gets hit high on his pad. Height might have been the issue here.
BEATEN! A leg-break, on a length, just outside off and turning away late. Bas de Leede prods to defend but the ball spins past his outside edge.
Fuller in length, outside off. Scott Edwards drives it to long off and rotates the strike.
Tossed up, around middle. Bas de Leede eases it down to long on for a run.
Back of a length, around off. Scott Edwards defends it out.
FOUR! A welcome boundary for Netherlands! A slower ball, fuller in length, outside off. Scott Edwards stays back and guides it past the keeper towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Short of a length, outsdie off. Bas de Leede steers it to third man for a run.
Good running! On a length, outside off. Bas de Leede punches it through the cover region for a couple of runs.
A stifled appeal for caught behind but the umpire says no! A leg-cutter, on a length, outside off. Bas de Leede skips down the track to drive but he misses.
On a length, around off. Bas de Leede defends it towards cover. The boundaries have certainly dried up for Netherlands!
Slightly shorter in length, oustdie off. Scott Edwards cuts it past the point fielder and comes back for the second run.
Floated, on a length, around leg. Scott Edwards paddles it towards short fine leg.
Flatter ball, on a length, around middle. Scott Edwards blocks it towards mid-wicket.
On a length, around off. Scott Edwards keeps it out.
Flatter ball, outside off. Scott Edwards goes for a reverse sweep but he misses and gets hit on his pad.
BEATEN! Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Scott Edwards looks to drive but the ball goes past his outside edge.
A slower ball, on a length, around leg. Scott Edwards nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Length ball, angling in from middle. Bas de Leede looks to flick but he gets an inside edge onto his pad. The ball rolls to the leg side and the batters collect a run.
Back of a length, around middle. Bas de Leede tucks it towards mid-wicket.
A bit fuller this time, around middle. Bas de Leede pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
On a length, around middle. Bas de Leede defends it off the back foot.
Good-length ball, on off. Scott Edwards keeps it out.
Beaten! Beauty by Rashid Khan! A loopy ball, outside off. Bas de Leede leans to block this but gets beaten as the ball turns away from him.
Floated, around middle. Bas de Leede flicks it to the fielder at mid on.
A googly this time, on middle. Scott Edwards tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A huge appeal for LBW, but the umpire is unmoved! A fuller ball, tossing it up, on middle. Scott Edwards, once again goes for the reverse-sweep, misses it this time and gets rapped on the front pad.
Tosses it up, on middle. Scott Edwards blocks it out.
A loopy ball, on middle. Scott Edwards leans and defends it out.
Outside off again, length ball. Scott Edwards pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Width on offer, good-length delivery. Scott Edwards slashes it towards deep cover for a brace.
On a length, outside off. Scott Edwards defends it out.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Bas de Leede pushes it to cover and takes off to the other end for a single.
Touch fuller, tad wide of the off pole. Bas de Leede drives it to cover.
Well bowled! On a length, in that channel outside off. Bas de Leede looks to have a poke at it but gets beaten.

DRINKS! Afghanistan would be happier of the two sides going into the drinks break! Yes, they haven't got a lot of wickets but their bowlers have kept the Dutch batters in check. Netherlands must ensure that there aren't too many dot balls and they keep rotating the strike. Afghanistan bowlers have put the brakes on scoring but they will now look to chip in with wickets and stay ahead in this contest.
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Scott Edwards leans across and blocks it towards mid on. 2 runs off Rashid Khan's first over.
Another floated delivery, outside off. Bas de Leede pushes it towards cover and scampers through to the other end.
Tosses it up, around middle. Bas de Leede leans and taps it to point.
Touch shorter, around middle. Scott Edwards pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Touch fuller, around off. Scott Edwards drives it to extra cover.
Rashid Khan begins with a quicker one, outside off. Scott Edwards stays back and looks to push it but misses.
Rashid Khan comes to bowl now.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Bas de Leede defends it out.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Scott Edwards looks to drive but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Scott Edwards pushes it towards cover.
Beaten! Good-length delivery, outside off, a hint of away movement. Scott Edwards looks to have a poke at it but misses.
Full in length, outside off, shaping away. Bas de Leede drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Gulbadin Naib starts off with a length delivery, outside off. Bas de Leede leans and drives it to the fielder at cover.
Gulbadin Naib comes into the attack now. He replaces Fareed Ahmad.
Shorter, outside off. Scott Edwards pushes it towards cover. Dot to the end over.
Quicker and flatter, on middle. Scott Edwards defends it out solidly.
FOUR! Fearless! This is the third time Scott Edwards has done that! Tosses it up, full again on middle. Scott Edwards gets low and reverse-sweeps this towards deep point for a boundary.
Loopy ball, fuller again, on middle. Scott Edwards lofts it over the bowler's head towards long on for a brace.
Another fuller length delivery, around off. Bas de Leede steps down and tucks it towards mid on for a quick single.
Loopy ball, full in length. Scott Edwards pushes it down to long off for a single.
Fuller in length this time, around off. Bas de Leede drives it back to the bowler. A maiden over from Fareed Ahmad!
A short ball, just outside off. Bas de Leede pulls it along the ground towards mid-wicket.
Length ball, angling in from off. Bas de Leede gets behind the line of the ball to block it.
Short of a length, around middle. Bas de Leede rides the bounce nicely and bunts it to the leg side.
Good-length ball, around off. Bas de Leede stands tall and punches it to the fielder at cover.
On a length, around off. Bas de Leede blocks it out.

A loud shout for a catch but the umpire is unmoved! Tossed up, on a length, around off. Scott Edwards gets down on his knee and looks to reverse sweep but he misses. The ball hits him on his forearm and pops out behind the sticks towards the slip fielder. The fielder takes it and Afghanistan appeal but the umpire is not interested! Top decision in the end from the umpire.
On a length, around middle. Scott Edwards blocks it off the front foot.
Flighted ball, outside off. Bas de Leede prods and defends it to the off side for an easy single.
Floated, on a length, around off. Bas de Leede keeps it out watchfully.
On a length, outside off. Bas de Leede lunges forward and drives it to the fielder at cover.
Tossed up, around off. Bas de Leede prods and pushes it back to the bowler.
Short of a length, angling down leg. Bas de Leede tucks it behind square on the leg side towards fine leg for a run.
Back of a length, around off. Bas de Leede keeps it out to the off side.

FOUR! Lovely timed shot and Bas de Leede fetches himself a boundary! Fuller in length, outside off. Bas de Leede leans into his drive and carves it past the mid off fielder. The ball races away to the fence.
Back of a length, just outside off. Bas de Leede looks to punch it through the off side but it goes off the toe end back to the bowler.
Length ball, angling in from off. Bas de Leede looks for a drive but it goes off the thick inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length, around off. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
FOUR! Lovely innovation from Edwards! Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Scott Edwards gets down on his knee and reverse-sweeps it past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Flatter ball, around off. Scott Edwards blocks it off the front foot.
On a length and drifting onto the pads. Scott Edwards misses his flick and gets hit on his pad.
Quick single! Tossed up, around middle. Bas de Leede pushes it towards mid on and scampers through to the other end.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Bas de Leede blocks it off the front foot.
Flatter ball, around leg. Bas de Leede keeps it out watchfully.
Sharafuddin Ashraf comes into the attack.
On a length, well outside off. Bas de Leede steers it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Bas de Leede dabs it onto the deck.
A bit fuller in length, outside off. Bas de Leede pushes it to the fielder at cover.
On a length, around off. Bas de Leede defends it to the off side.
An appeal for LBW but the umpire says no! Length ball, jagging back in a bit from outside off. Bas de Leede misses his flick and gets hit high on his pad.
Leg bye! Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Scott Edwards misses his flick and gets hit on his pad. The ball rolls away to the leg side for a leg bye.
Flatter, spinning it in on middle. Bas de Leede blocks it out towards square leg.
Another fuller length ball, outside off. Bas de Leede drives, but finds the man at cover.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Bas de Leede leans and blocks it out.
Touch fuller, around middle. Scott Edwards flicks it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Loopy ball, around middle. Scott Edwards presses forward and defends it out.
FOUR! Cheeky! Perfectly executed by Scott Edwards. A fuller ball, around middle. Scott Edwards gets low and reverse-sweeps this past the point fielder for a boundary.
This one was outside off, on a length. Bas de Leede defends it out.
Fuller length delivery, outside off. Bas de Leede lunges and blocks it out solidly.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Bas de Leede drives it to cover. No run there!
Fuller again, outside off. Bas de Leede leaves it alone.
Bas de Leede is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Netherlands have lost another wicket here! Fareed Ahmad strikes this time and sends back Colin Ackermann. A fuller ball, outside off. Colin Ackermann looks to go for the lofted drive but miscues his shot to the cover fielder. Gulbadin Naib moves quickly to his left and takes an excellent catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Gulbadin Naib b Fareed Ahmad

Commentary.Commentary: Another length delivery, outside off. Scott Edwards guides it towards third man for a single.
WDE! Length ball, wide of off. Scott Edwards leaves it alone and wide is called by the umpire.
Fuller ball, tosses it up. Scott Edwards sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single. He retains the strike.
Loopy ball, full, on middle. Scott Edwards leans and defends it out watchfully.
Fuller again, slower through the air. Scott Edwards presses forward and drives to cover. Another dot ball.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Scott Edwards leans and blocks it out on the off side.
Loopy ball, around middle. Scott Edwards tucks it to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Quicker this time, outside off. Scott Edwards hangs back and taps it towards point.
Touch shorter, around off. Colin Ackermann covers the line and blocks it out solidly.
Back of a length, outside off. Colin Ackermann shows the full face of the bat and defends it out.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! That was a powerful strike by Colin Ackermann! An overpitched delivery, outside off. Colin Ackermann waits for it and smashes it past mid off for a cracking boundary.
Good-length delivery, on middle. Colin Ackermann taps it towards point. Dot ball.
Beaten! A pacy delivery, on a length, outside off. Colin Ackermann looks to cut it away but gets beaten.
Fareed Ahmad starts off with a length ball, wide of off. Colin Ackermann hangs back and chops it to the fielder at cover-point.
Fareed Ahmad comes to bowl now.
Fuller ball, on the pads this time. Scott Edwards flicks it away towards deep square leg for a brace.
Another fuller, ball, on middle. Scott Edwards blocks it watchfully.
Loopy ball, outside off. Scott Edwards lunges and blocks it towards point. No run there!
Quick single! Touch shorter, around middle. Colin Ackermann taps it towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Flatter, around middle. Colin Ackermann, on the back foot, defends it out.
Slower through the air, full and on middle. Colin Ackermann leans and blocks it out.

FOUR! CRUNCHED! Short, wide and it gets the treatment! Back of a length, outside off. Scott Edwards stays back and cuts it past the point fielder. The ball races away to the fence and that spoils a good over!
On a length, around off. Scott Edwards keeps it out off the front foot.
Cut hard but straight to the fielder! Short of a length, outside off. Scott Edwards hangs back to cut but finds the fielder at cover-point.
Good-length delivery, around off. Scott Edwards defends it to the off side.
Fuller in length, around middle. Scott Edwards flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Good-length ball, around middle. Scott Edwards blocks it to the on side.

A stifled appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved! A googly, on a length, around middle and spinning in late. Colin Ackermann misses his flick and gets hit on his pad. That would have probably spun down leg.
On a length, around off. Colin Ackermann keeps it out.
Colin Ackermann walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Not the way in which Mujeeb Ur Rahman would have liked to grab a wicket but he wouldn't mind this at all! Much-needed breakthrough for Afghanistan and Netherlands lose their first wicket. This was a flatter ball, turning in down leg. Musa Ahmed looks to flick but he only gets a tickle on it. Rahmanullah Gurbaz, behind the sticks moves quickly to his right and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Rahmanullah Gurbaz b Mujeeb Ur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, around off. Musa Ahmed blocks it off the front foot.
Flatter ball, on a length, around middle. Scott Edwards eases it down to long on for a single.
On a length, outside off. Scott Edwards pushes it to the man at mid off.
Wide! Full ball, drifting down leg. Scott Edwards misses his sweep and the umpire calls it as a wide.
Back of a length, around off. Musa Ahmed defends it onto the deck. Another good over for Netherlands as 8 runs came off it.
FOUR! Excellent placement! Length ball, just outside off and shaping away a bit. Musa Ahmed gets forward and carves it through the cover-point region for a boundary.
TWO WIDES! Length ball, drifting down leg. Scott Edwards misses his flick and the keeper fails to grab it cleanly. The batters sneak in a bye.
Slashed but just the single. Full ball, outside off. Musa Ahmed lunges forward and throws his bat at it. It goes off the thick outside edge towards third man for a run.
Short of a length, around off. Musa Ahmed opens the face of the bat and taps it towards backward point. No run there!
Good-length ball, around off. Musa Ahmed prods and pushes it to the fielder at mid off.
Back of a length, outside off. Scott Edwards cuts it through the cover-point region and takes off for a run. The fielder there has a shy at the striker's end but he misses.
Flat and on middle. Scott Edwards turns it towards mid-wicket for a run.
On a length, drifted onto the pads. Musa Ahmed clips it towards the square leg region for a single.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Musa Ahmed keeps it out.
Flatter ball, on a length, going on with the angle. Musa Ahmed tucks it to the leg side.
Tossed up, around off. Musa Ahmed blocks it off the front foot.
Rahman starts with a full-length delivery, on the pads. Scott Edwards clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman will bowl from the other end.

Leg bye! Fuller in length, angling in from middle. Scott Edwards misses his flick and gets hit low on his pad. The ball rolls to the leg side for a leg bye. Good start from Netherlands! 8 runs off the first over!
FOUR! CLOBBERED! Back of a length, just outside off. Scott Edwards hangs back and whacks it in front of square past the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Fuller in length, outside off. Scott Edwards digs it out towards cover.
Wide! Ahmadzai errs in line and sprays it down leg. Scott Edwards leaves it alone and the umpire calls it as a wide.
On a length, around off. Scott Edwards blocks it to the off side.
Length ball, angling in from middle. Scott Edwards clips it to the leg side and comes back for the second run. Edwards and Netherlands are up and running!
Yamin Ahmadzai starts with a length ball, around off. Scott Edwards defends it to the off side.
